title: EHR Consultant Rate Guide 2026
subtitle: Know market rates before hiring your EHR expert
description: Medical groups budgeting EHR implementation projects need accurate consultant pricing to evaluate proposals and allocate resources. This guide breaks down 2026 market rates by credential level, geography, and project scope.
bullets: West Coast 35% premium; Midwest rates 15% below national average

title: EHR Consultant Vetting Guide
subtitle: Avoid costly EHR implementations by vetting the right consultant
description: Before hiring an EHR consultant, medical groups must evaluate credentials, track record, and platform expertise. This guide explains what to look for—including CPHIMS certification and implementation success markers—to avoid costly project failures and ensure vendor alignment.
bullets: Verify CPHIMS certification—the credential standard in EHR consulting
Request proven implementation track records for your EHR platform
Confirm clinic-size and specialty experience, including multi-location setups
Compare go-live timelines, costs, and post-launch support

title: EHR Implementation Checklist

Data validation steps ensuring patient record accuracy
